subject: Re: Deployment mode options and migration next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rahul Desai <rahul@luminalabs.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@luminalabs.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Deployment options recap + next steps (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Rahul / Priya -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we have alignment on requirements and next steps: 

- Current setup: Lumina Labs is using a mix of a public LLM API and an internal self-hosted cluster for high-volume workloads.
- Primary goals: reduce per-token cost for high-throughput inference, improve tail latency for interactive features, and centralize model ops to avoid duplicated infra work.
- Compliance: some customers in healthcare require network isolation / on-prem options and a SOC 2 attestation.
- Key asks from you: expected QPS and peak concurrency for your chat endpoint, rough monthly token volume, and whether you need private VPC/on-prem for the initial pilot or just Dedicated reserved capacity.

From our side, options: 
- Hosted API: fastest path to test functionality and compare quality; good for initial eval and low friction.
- Dedicated: recommended if you care about predictable throughput and want reserved GPU capacity (we can size for your peak).
- Private (VPC/on-prem): best for regulated workloads or when you must control network egress; we can package a private control plane for air-gapped installs but that takes longer (4-8 weeks typical prep).

Attachments: Redwood-Dedicated-Overview.pdf (high-level config & pricing). I also attached our SOC2 summary on request - happy to share the full report under an NDA.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Can you share projected tokens/month and peak concurrent requests? (helps us recommend Dedicated instance sizes)
2) If you want a technical deep-dive, I suggest looping in Marcus (cc'd) for sizing and migration plan. Available slots: Monday/Tuesday next week.
3) If you'd like a pilot, we can prepare a 6-week pilot SOW (standard pilot discounts apply).

Happy to jump on a quick follow-up - let me know what works.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Dedicated-Overview.pdf; SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Rahul Desai <rahul@luminalabs.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@luminalabs.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment options recap + next steps (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Thanks Marissa - really helpful summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- Tokens/month (current): ~850M tokens/month across ingestion + chat. Expect growth to ~1.5B in 6 months.
- Peak concurrency: our chat real-time endpoint sees ~120 concurrent steady users, spikes to ~450 for promos.
- Primary target for pilot: we want to move the high-throughput batched workloads first (recommend Dedicated) and keep the interactive chat on the public API while we validate latency. For the regulated customers, we will need a Private VPC option eventually - not required for the initial pilot but important for the roadmap.

Two items: 1) we need SOC2 documentation and a simple network diagram showing VPC peering options and how data flows for Private mode; 2) any timeframe estimate for Dedicated provisioning and migration lift (we have an internal deadline in Q1 to reduce inference costs).

I can share a demo dataset and representative traffic pattern if that helps with sizing.

Thanks,
Rahul
Head of Platform
Lumina Labs

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rahul Desai <rahul@luminalabs.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@luminalabs.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment options recap + next steps (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Great - thanks for the numbers, Rahul. That gives us what we need to recommend an initial configuration. High-level plan and timing: 

1) Recommendation: start with Redwood Dedicated for the batched, high-throughput workloads. We can size a 4x A100-equivalent pool to handle 1.5B tokens/month with headroom for spikes; this also gives predictable unit economics.
2) Interactive chat: keep on Hosted API for the short term while we run latency tests against Dedicated; if latency meets your SLOs we can shift chat to Dedicated (or run hybrid routing).
3) Private VPC/on-prem: we'll treat this as Phase 2. Typical lead time to stand up a private VPC + k8s private control plane is 4-6 weeks after contract and network approvals. Full on-prem air-gapped installs are longer (6-10 weeks) and usually reserved for regulated deployments.

I've attached a draft SOW for a 6-week pilot (SOW-pilot-draft.docx) and the SOC2-summary.pdf. For Dedicated provisioning, typical timeline after signed SOW and PO is 7-10 business days to reserve capacity and deploy the model variants you select.

Next actions: 
- Rahul / Priya: send the demo dataset and a traffic sample (we can accept a sanitized gzip) - that will help Marcus validate throughput assumptions.
- Marcus: can you confirm availability for a deep-dive next Tue/Wed and whether the 4x sizing looks right based on their traffic?
- Rahul: if you want us to draft a pilot PO, we can include standard pilot discounts; will also share pricing tiers in the SOW.

Thanks - I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the technical deep-dive once Marcus confirms.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: SOW-pilot-draft.docx; SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
